_note: Esempio. La skill style-bible scrive la versione vera in analysis/style-recipes.json. Nomi di file come appaiono nelle cartelle models/ di ComfyUI.

background.prompt: hand-painted 1990s point-and-click adventure background, same composition, crisp painted details, original color palette, soft gouache texture, game_style
background.negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, watermark, extra people, modern objects, bloom, lens flare, oversharpened

background_extension.prompt: continuation of the same hand-painted 1990s adventure game scene, matching perspective, horizon and lighting, no characters, no doors, no readable text, game_style
background_extension.negative: photorealistic, people, characters, signs with text, doors, seams, frame, border

sprite.prompt: clean hand-drawn cartoon character from a 1990s adventure game, identical pose and silhouette, flat cel shading, game_style
sprite.negative: different pose, extra limbs, realistic face, real person likeness, background
